description: This file defines the control panel configuration for a Superset chart plugin, specifically for an ag-grid table with advanced controls including query modes, column customization, formatting, and conditional styling.

methods.name: getQueryMode
methods.description: Determines the current query mode (Aggregate or Raw) based on control states.

methods.name: processComparisonColumns
methods.description: Generates comparison column labels and values for a given column, used for conditional formatting and comparison features.

methods.name: isQueryMode
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if the current controls are in a specific query mode.

methods.name: validateAggControlValues
methods.description: Validates that groupby and metrics controls have values when in aggregate mode.
